Apple___Apple_scab.description: Fungal disease (Venturia inaequalis) causing olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves and fruit.
Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Remove fallen leaves, prune for airflow, spray captan or myclobutanil from bud break; plant resistant varieties.

Apple___Black_rot.description: Fungal disease (Botryosphaeria obtusa) causing purple-edged leaf spots ('frog-eye') and rotting fruit.
Apple___Black_rot.treatment: Prune out dead wood and cankers, remove mummified fruit, apply captan or thiophanate-methyl.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.description: Fungal disease needing both apple and juniper/cedar hosts; bright yellow-orange spots on leaves.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.treatment: Remove nearby junipers if possible, spray myclobutanil at pink bud stage, use resistant varieties.

Apple___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Apple___healthy.treatment: Keep regular watering, balanced fertilizer and seasonal pruning.

Blueberry___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Blueberry___healthy.treatment: Maintain acidic soil (pH 4.5-5.5), mulch and water regularly.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.description: Fungal disease (Podosphaera clandestina) forming white powdery patches on young leaves.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Improve air circulation, avoid excess nitrogen, apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate sprays.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.treatment: Continue regular care: pruning, watering and pest monitoring.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.description: Fungal disease (Cercospora zeae-maydis) causing long, rectangular grey-tan lesions between leaf veins.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.treatment: Rotate crops, till residue, plant resistant hybrids, apply strobilurin or triazole fungicide if severe.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.description: Fungal disease (Puccinia sorghi) with small reddish-brown powdery pustules on both leaf surfaces.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Plant resistant hybrids; apply fungicide (e.g. azoxystrobin) early if infection is heavy.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.description: Fungal disease (Exserohilum turcicum) causing long cigar-shaped grey-green lesions.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Use resistant hybrids, rotate crops, manage residue, apply fungicide at tasseling if needed.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Corn_(maize)___healthy.treatment: Maintain proper spacing, nitrogen supply and irrigation.

Grape___Black_rot.description: Fungal disease (Guignardia bidwellii) causing brown circular leaf spots and shrivelled black berries.
Grape___Black_rot.treatment: Remove mummified berries and infected leaves, open the canopy, spray mancozeb or myclobutanil.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).description: Trunk disease caused by several fungi; 'tiger-stripe' yellow/brown leaf patterns and spotted berries.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).treatment: Prune out infected wood, protect pruning wounds, remove severely affected vines.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.description: Fungal disease (Pseudocercospora vitis) causing dark brown irregular spots and early leaf drop.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.treatment: Remove infected leaves, improve airflow, apply copper-based or mancozeb fungicide.

Grape___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Grape___healthy.treatment: Continue canopy management, balanced nutrition and regular scouting.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).description: Bacterial disease spread by the Asian citrus psyllid; blotchy yellow mottling, lopsided bitter fruit. No cure.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).treatment: Control psyllids with insecticides, remove infected trees, plant certified disease-free nursery stock.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial disease (Xanthomonas arboricola) causing small angular dark spots that fall out, leaving 'shot holes'.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Plant resistant varieties, apply copper sprays in early season, avoid overhead irrigation.

Peach___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Peach___healthy.treatment: Maintain pruning, thinning and balanced fertilization.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial disease (Xanthomonas spp.) causing small water-soaked spots that turn brown on leaves and fruit.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Use disease-free seed, rotate crops, apply copper sprays, avoid working with wet plants.

Pepper,_bell___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Pepper,_bell___healthy.treatment: Keep consistent watering and mulch to prevent stress.

Potato___Early_blight.description: Fungal disease (Alternaria solani) causing brown spots with concentric 'target' rings on older leaves.
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Remove infected leaves, rotate crops, apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb, keep plants well fed.

Potato___Late_blight.description: Water-mould disease (Phytophthora infestans) causing dark water-soaked patches with white mould; spreads fast.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Destroy infected plants immediately, apply metalaxyl or mancozeb, use certified seed potatoes.

Potato___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Potato___healthy.treatment: Continue hilling, regular watering and scouting for blight in humid weather.

Raspberry___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Raspberry___healthy.treatment: Prune old canes after fruiting and keep rows well ventilated.

Soybean___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Soybean___healthy.treatment: Maintain crop rotation and regular field scouting.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.description: Fungal disease forming white powdery spots on leaves; reduces yield and weakens plants.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.treatment: Space plants for airflow, remove badly infected leaves, spray sulfur, neem oil or potassium bicarbonate.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.description: Fungal disease (Diplocarpon earlianum) causing many small purple spots that merge, making leaves look burnt.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.treatment: Remove infected leaves after harvest, avoid overhead watering, renovate beds, apply captan if severe.

Strawberry___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Strawberry___healthy.treatment: Mulch, water at the base and renew plants every few years.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.description: Bacterial disease (Xanthomonas spp.) causing small dark greasy spots on leaves and scabby fruit.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Use clean seed and transplants, apply copper sprays, rotate crops, avoid overhead irrigation.

Tomato___Early_blight.description: Fungal disease (Alternaria solani) with brown target-like rings on lower leaves, causing yellowing.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Remove lower infected leaves, mulch, stake plants, apply chlorothalonil or copper fungicide.

Tomato___Late_blight.description: Water-mould disease (Phytophthora infestans) with large greasy grey-brown patches; can destroy crops in days.
Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants, apply mancozeb or chlorothalonil preventively in wet weather.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.description: Fungal disease (Passalora fulva) with yellow spots on top and olive-green mould underneath; common in greenhouses.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Lower humidity, increase ventilation, remove infected leaves, use resistant varieties.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.description: Fungal disease (Septoria lycopersici) causing many small round spots with dark borders and grey centres.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.treatment: Remove infected lower leaves, mulch, avoid wetting foliage, apply chlorothalonil or copper.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.description: Pest damage from tiny mites (Tetranychus urticae) causing yellow speckling and fine webbing.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.treatment: Spray water on leaf undersides, use insecticidal soap or neem oil, introduce predatory mites.

Tomato___Target_Spot.description: Fungal disease (Corynespora cassiicola) causing brown spots with light centres and concentric rings.
Tomato___Target_Spot.treatment: Improve airflow, remove crop debris, apply chlorothalonil or azoxystrobin.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.description: Viral disease spread by whiteflies; leaves curl upward, turn yellow, and plants become stunted. No cure.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.treatment: Control whiteflies (yellow sticky traps, insecticides), remove infected plants, use resistant varieties.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.description: Viral disease causing light and dark green mosaic patterns and distorted leaves; spreads by touch and tools.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.treatment: Remove infected plants, disinfect tools and hands, use resistant varieties. No chemical cure.

Tomato___healthy.description: No disease detected. The leaf looks healthy.
Tomato___healthy.treatment: Continue staking, mulching and watering at the base.
